title: Punishment
text: “Sigh… Kou, what do you think of your friends—not to mention Keel-kun?”
“Hmm? Hurry up with dinner!”
I guess that was the trigger? Father’s gentle gaze turned slightly stern.
“…I see, I see. So Kou, you’re just dying to eat Keel-kun, aren’t you?”
“Yeah!”

Kou nodded energetically, with all his might. W-what’s this!? A tense, ominous atmosphere began to take hold of the room. I have to make Kou apologize right away! My instincts, honed alongside Filolial-sama, are telling me I absolutely must.
“Well then, Kou… let’s have you experience the same fear that Keel-kun felt. If you still don’t get it after that, there’s nothing I can do—and I’ll have to abandon you.”
“Huh!?”
Father grabbed Kou by the throat. Of course, Father can’t actually attack him. But he can certainly grab him and immobilize him.
“Well then… I suppose Kou will be my next meal.”
“Huh? Huh? Huh?”

Kou’s eyes are darting back and forth as he struggles to comprehend the situation. Father’s anger is justified, but since it was a child’s mistake, I hope he’ll forgive him. I opened my mouth to convey that.
“Father, let’s call it a day—”
“Motoyasu, just keep quiet. Whatever you do… don’t you dare go against my decision.”
“Y-yes!”
Wow… what is this? This sense of intimidation reminds me of my future father. I found myself nodding without thinking.

“Kou, you’d better understand the meaning of the word ‘slaughter.’ You’re a Filolial… a monster that pulls carriages—neither human nor Demi-Human. And there are breeds of Filolials classified as meat animals; they’re even sold in stores. You understand what that means, right?”
“Huh? Wha—? K-Kou isn’t like that—”

“Even if you grew up in a special way thanks to the Hero raising you, that fact doesn’t change, right? I mean, I’m sure there are taboos even among humans or Demi-Humans, but hey, you’re a Filolial. It’s not a taboo for us.”
“U-uwaaaaaa…”
Kou reaches out to me with teary eyes, seeking help. But my Father grabs that hand.

“I won’t let you ask Motoyasu-kun for help. You didn’t listen no matter how many times Keel-kun told you, and just like you did to him, I’ll keep targeting you constantly. In the end, I’ll just do it when Motoyasu-kun isn’t around.”
“N-no way! Kou! Kou won’t lose to Iwatani! There’s absolutely no way Iwatani can do anything to Kou!”

“Sigh… I thought I might forgive you if you showed some remorse, but it seems that’s not going to happen. Since you’re having your throat squeezed right now, you should understand that there are plenty of ways to finish you off without me even having to deliver the final blow, right?”
Kou’s face suddenly turns pale. Oh… I’m overcome with the urge to rush in and save him right now, but since the one holding him is my Father, what on earth am I supposed to do?
“I’m not sure if Sakura-chan will go through with it, but Gaelion-chan… in the worst-case scenario, if Keel-kun were to bite through Kou’s windpipe… it’d be over in a flash, wouldn’t it?”

My father shifts the hand gripping Kou’s throat and moves behind him. With deft skill, he pulls a rope from his shield and begins to tie Kou up. Everyone present is left speechless by his skill and efficiency.
“Now then…”
Picking up the remaining embers from the campfire, Father begins to draw lines on Kou’s feathers. What are those dotted lines he’s drawing?
“This is where the wing starts. Kou moves around a lot, so I think his meat will be firm and delicious, don’t you?”
“Ugh! I can’t move! Ugh!”

Father pins down Kou from above as he struggles to break free. Even Kou, as strong as he is, is no match for my enhanced Father—he can’t move a muscle. Oh… my heart is pounding so hard I can’t even speak.
Father, please stop. Kou hasn’t done anything wrong. It’s me, Motoyasu, who’s at fault—please forgive me!
That’s what I’m tempted to say as this incredibly realistic threat continues. As for why I’m able to stay still, it’s because every now and then, my Father winks at me as a signal.

It’s just a way of disciplining him—he doesn’t really intend to go through with it. That’s why I, Motoyasu, can just stay silent and watch how things play out. If this weren’t my Father but someone else, I’d make them pay with their life.
“Now then, Keel, tear out Kou’s windpipe.”
“Huh? But… and besides…”
Keel seems hesitant. However, just as my Father said, Keel takes a few steps forward and glances back and forth between the line drawn on Kou and my Father.
“These are… the butchering lines for cutting him up with a knife after I’ve finished him off.”
“Eek!”
With a convincing performance, my Father presses the kitchen knife hanging from his waist against Kou’s cheek, as if to show it off to him.

“You know what this is, right? I’ve butchered monsters right in front of you many times… It’s necessary to cut Kou up into delicious pieces. First off, what should we make with the wings? Fried chicken? We’ll use the bones for soup… There’s no waste in Filolial, right?”
“Gyaa! You’re scaring me!”

Kou let out a scream at my father’s threat. Even if I save him, he’ll be targeted at the first opportunity, and the same thing will happen when I’m not around. Under my father’s threat, Kou’s feathers are falling out one by one.
“Oh, maybe I’ll pour the sauce I ordered using Keel-kun’s recipe over Kou. Then I’ll have Keel-kun bite through Kou’s windpipe—yeah.”
“No, no way!”
Kou blurted out, his eyes brimming with tears as he pleaded like never before.
“Kou isn’t… Kou isn’t food! I’m not food!”
“Kou, are you trying to say that Keel-kun is food? So this is what you’ve been nagging Keel-kun about. Now, how many times have you told Keel-kun the same thing, Kou?”
“Ugh… Kitamura! Yuki, Sakura, Luna! H-help me!”
Just as Kou cried out for help, he got a glare from his Father. I can’t move like this! Ugh… Kou, I want to rush to your aid right now, but my legs…
This is… a trial. Motoyasu, is this the extent of your love for Filolial-sama? Is it love to let your Father cook Filolial-sama?
Love… it is love. Love is freedom… if it has anything to do with Filo-tan, I am prepared to accept anything. Anything is permissible in the name of love.
It’s all fate… Just as I am destined to pursue Filo-tan, Kou has his own destiny. Certainly, I will do my utmost to save Kou with my very life.

But our opponent is my Father—Filo-tan’s parent and an absolute authority. And that very Father has declared he wishes to eat Filolial-sama. Yet I, Motoyasu, cannot abandon Filolial-sama, not even for a single moment. Well then—
“Ah! Smoke’s coming out of Spear Guy’s head, and he’s stopped moving!?”

“…It’s no good. Motoyasu-sama has frozen up, caught in an internal conflict between Naofumi-sama’s conflicting orders and Kou’s cries for help. Kou, you’ll have to give up on Motoyasu-sama’s rescue and just surrender to fate.”
“Kitamura! Help meee!”
“With Motoyasu-kun—our last hope—in this state, Kou’s life as good as over.”
“Yuki, Sakura, Luna, help me!”
Yuki-chan, Sakura-chan, and Luna-chan have also frozen in place under Father’s glare. Well, Luna-chan is a different story.
“Keel-kun isn’t food. Kou, who’s targeting Keel-kun, is the enemy…”
Coldly pushed away, Kou puts up a life-or-death struggle and lets out a scream that seems to tear the air apart. His gaze is fixed on Yuki and Sakura.
“Um… Since Lord Naofumi desires Kou, I have no way to stop it. Yes… If it weren’t Lord Naofumi, I could have done anything, but I picked the wrong opponent.”
“Um… Sakura… Hmm, sorry—Naofumi is Sakura’s master, so even if I wanted to help, I can’t.”
Since Keel is already the enemy, the only ones left are the Assistant and the monster. The Assistant seems to be able to do nothing but look around nervously, darting his eyes this way and that.
“Gau!”
What did the monster say? The tears streaming from Kou’s eyes only increased.
“I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry! Please, don’t eat me!”
“Saying that to me just sounds like a pathetic plea for mercy. Isn’t that something you should be saying to Keel?”
“Keel, I’m sorry! I won’t do it again. So… so please save me!”
Kou apologized to Keel over and over, big tears streaming from his eyes.
“B-big brother… isn’t it okay now?”
“No way. Kou, you haven’t shown any remorse at all, have you? It might just be an empty promise.”
“N-no way! I’m not lying! I’m not lying! I’m sorry! I’m sorry! I’ll never do it again, so please help me!”
“Remember this well, okay? Just as you’re always targeting Keel-kun, you’re being targeted too.”
With that, Father let Kou go. Exhausted from screaming, Kou slumped down and was being comforted by Keel as he sniffled and sobbed.
“I won’t do it again. I’m sorry, please forgive me… I’m sorry.”
“Sigh… I really don’t want to have to do this, you know. Make sure you remember this.”
“If he shows remorse once, it won’t happen again! Filolial-sama is wise, after all!”
“Whoa!　Motoyasu-kun, you just snapped out of your stupor and blurted that out?”
My father, his expression back to its usual gentle self, said to me in surprise.
“Sakura, that gave me a scare—Naofumi, you’re so scary!”
“I thought so too.”
“I was surprised too. Big bro really does act differently depending on the time and situation.”
“Yeah, that was a shock.”
Sakura, Yuki, Keel, and Luna all said that. My assistant is breathing a sigh of relief. The monster, on the other hand, is clicking his tongue.
“Well, what could I do? Just the moment I looked away, Keel-kun got eaten… That’s no joke.”
“Ugh… It’s scary to think that way…”

Keel is shivering. On the other hand, Kou has been crying the whole time. I lean in close to Kou, sit him down a little ways away, and try to comfort him. It’s okay to hate me for being caught in the middle and unable to do anything.

I’m… a very weak man… In a situation like this, the old me would have reached out to the crying child in front of me without hesitation… Ah, I haven’t made any progress at all. In a situation like this, where is the best choice?

When my Father ordered me to slaughter all of Filolial-sama’s followers, what… am I supposed to do? I can’t disobey the order, but I also can’t bring myself to hurt Filolial-sama. …No, there’s another problem here as well. It’s not just about Father’s orders… what would happen to me if the enemy were to enslave Filolial-sama?
Fortunately, I haven’t faced such a situation yet, but I can’t say it’s impossible. What should I do in a situation like that?

By the way, since then, Kou hasn’t mentioned wanting to eat Keel anymore. Father’s punishment is incredibly effective, isn’t it? I wonder if Filo-tan has ever done anything that would warrant a punishment from Father? Just thinking about it gives me chills.
Incidentally, after this incident, a shared understanding emerged among Filolial-sama and the others that Father is the ultimate authority. Everyone has started listening to Father without question.
